name: When should I consider a full bathroom remodel versus a minor update?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full bathroom remodel versus a minor update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a full bathroom remodel if your current bathroom has significant functional issues, an outdated layout, or extensive damage that cannot be resolved with minor repairs. A full remodel allows for changes to plumbing, electrical, and structural elements, offering a completely new space. A minor update is suitable for cosmetic changes like new paint, fixtures, or vanity replacements when the underlying structure is sound and the layout is functional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a full remodel for significant functional issues or outdated layouts; opt for minor updates for cosmetic changes.
